verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Xero's AI-assisted bank reconciliation (JAX) and draft bills awaiting approval, but nothing documents a month-end close checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs. Those are adjacent features, not the close-checklist capability the story asks for. A close workflow is a fair axis for accounting software, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
